title: Weak convergence of the stochastic proximal point method in metric spaces
summary: We prove the almost sure weak convergence of a stochastic proximal point method for minimizing a convex integral function in the general nonlinear context of complete geodesic metric spaces of nonpositive curvature (so-called Hadamard spaces), solving a problem of M. Bačák. This method, formulated in the context of a mild growth condition on the function which generalizes Lipschitz continuity, was previously only considered in the context of strong metric regularity conditions or in the context of locally compact spaces (all of which immediately induce strong convergence).
